title: chamaecytisus hirsutus subsp. ciliatus
intro: Chamaecytisus hirsutus subsp. ciliatus, commonly known as Russian broom or Scotch broom, is a flowering plant species native to Eastern Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Chamaecytisus hirsutus subsp. ciliatus include acting as a diuretic, expectorant, and antiseptic, which can help alleviate conditions such as urinary tract infections and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
